detail: self-check failed: check test failed before the verifier: `cargo test --locked` (exit code 101); redacted report: {"summary":"Root cause: failure_section, the one place that picks a failed check's stored output, knew only runner markers and a cleanup header. A log with a headerless cleanup block fell through to a plain tail of cleanup text, and nothing said when no failing section was found. It also never read the shard's `== shard` and `units failed:` lines, so a failing unit's output gave way to later passing units. Fix: checks.rs gets one cleanup recogniser that matches by content and cuts a trailing block with a backward walk; a log of only cleanup becomes an explicit note. gh/client.rs keeps the failing unit's own output and collapses the passing units, and adds one trailing 'no failing test section' note counted inside the limits. send_back.rs re-cuts stored output before the 3000-byte tail. New tests are in checks.rs, gh/client.rs, send_back.rs and routing.rs; the CHANGELOG has the entry.
